## 1.39.1-rokid.1 (2026-09-27)

Morphe Patches 1.39.1 with the **Rokid controls** patch for YouTube 21.04.223 on Rokid glasses: player rail, options panel (speed, quality, captions, caption language), sections and search, R08 ring navigation, native scrims hidden, playback reminders removed, automatic captions off by default.
